title: embedding
instructions: A tool call that creates something is answered with the nearest few existing entities of its kind, each a `hit` whose `near` names the new one. When one of them is the same thing, keep the one that stands: update it, and delete the new one.

vector_check.title: Check the vector index
vector_check.description: Check the vector index used to rank entities by semantic similarity. Reports missing embedding configuration, a missing vector table, a database without sqlite-vector installed, or two models' vectors sharing the table during a re-embed; in those cases every search reads every stored vector. Fails when the index is owed a build (never built, or too many vectors changed since) and the newest vector is older than the server's stale threshold, 30 minutes by default: a stopped sweep process, which leaves searches exact but slower. Takes no arguments. Returns a report in content.body, with warning or failure findings when present; it does not repair the records or configuration.
